{"step":2,"file":"src/daemon/protocols/cdp.c","function":"cdp_decode","line":536,"var":"fdp","code":"if (fdp) {","note":"When the frame is treated as FDP, the code interprets the TLV payload as a string instead of a fixed-width integer."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/daemon/protocols/cdp.c","function":"cdp_decode","line":538,"var":"pos","code":"if (!strncmp(\"Router\", (char*)pos, tlv_len))","note":"The comparison reads tlv_len bytes from the packet buffer without first requiring a NUL terminator or a minimum length."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/daemon/protocols/cdp.c","function":"cdp_decode","line":538,"var":"tlv_len","code":"if (!strncmp(\"Router\", (char*)pos, tlv_len))","note":"A crafted TLV length larger than the literal string length makes strncmp continue reading past the end of the attacker-controlled TLV into adjacent memory."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/daemon/protocols/cdp.c","function":"cdp_decode","line":546,"var":"chassis->c_cap_available","code":"chassis->c_cap_available = chassis->c_cap_enabled;","note":"The over-read influences protocol state after the unsafe comparison, confirming the vulnerable read path in the decoder."}
]

path.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
